doc_name: 钢铁产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 严格控制新增产能，不再核准和支持单纯新建、扩建产能的钢铁项目
quote_en: Strictly control new capacity; no longer approve or support projects that merely build or expand capacity.
notes: Dedicated plan, mixed: demand stabilisation, tech-upgrade funds, export-tax tweaks and M&A support sit alongside capacity control and scrapping (300 m3 and below blast furnaces; 72 Mt iron / 25 Mt steel by 2011). Dominant = supply control (judgement); L1-wide.

doc_name: 钢铁产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 积极推进河北司家营、山西袁家村等大型铁矿资源开发，提高国产铁矿石自给率
quote_en: Actively push development of large iron-ore resources such as Siyingzi and Yuanjiacun to raise domestic ore self-sufficiency.
notes: Also 鼓励有条件的大型企业到国外独资或合资办矿; 鼓励攀西、承德钒钛资源综合利用. Regulatory side: 规范进口铁矿石市场秩序. L2 mapping is a judgement.

doc_name: 钢铁产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 重点发展高速铁路用钢、高强度轿车用钢、高档电力用钢和工模具钢、特殊大锻材等关键钢材品种
quote_en: Focus on developing key steel grades: high-speed-rail steel, high-strength auto steel, high-grade power steel, tool and die steel, special heavy forgings.
notes: Sub-concept with opposite stance to the headline (product-mix upgrading). Also 高磁感取向硅钢 and extra-thick plate for nuclear/thermal power.
